patch_description:
Retains the successful routing-screened archive search, but adds a locally trained move model alongside the global predictor. Ranking weights adapt to observed within-batch LP ordering accuracy rather than trusting either predictor unconditionally. Energy and exploration retain guaranteed evaluation slots.

Cached energies, bit-mask diversity checks, bounded training sets, and size-adaptive routing shortlists reduce screening overhead. Target-directed degree-preserving exchanges improve path relinking, while rotations and random kicks remain available for escaping local optima.
